# @egjs/flicking

> A reliable, flexible, and extendable carousel library used by 30+ million people daily. Supports vanilla JS and major frameworks (React, Vue3, Angular, Svelte, Preact) with circular mode, SSR, rich plugin system, and full TypeScript support.

Flicking is a production-ready carousel/slider with comprehensive API, event system, framework integrations, and a plugin system. Use `@egjs/flicking` for vanilla JS and `@egjs/react-flicking`, `@egjs/vue3-flicking` for framework-specific wrappers. Plugins (AutoPlay, Fade, Parallax, etc.) are provided separately via `@egjs/flicking-plugins`.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/quickstart): Installation and basic setup for vanilla JS, React, and Vue3
- [HTML Structure & Styling](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/structure-and-styling): Required DOM structure (`.flicking-viewport` > `.flicking-camera` > panels) and CSS classes
- [Controlling Flicking](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/controlling-flicking): Programmatic control — `next()`, `prev()`, `moveTo()`, `index`, `currentPanel`
- [Common Option Recipes](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/option-recipes): Practical configuration patterns for common use cases

## Framework Guides

- [React Guide](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/react-guide): `@egjs/react-flicking` — `<Flicking>`, `<ViewportSlot>`, event props, panel update patterns
- [Vue3 Guide](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/guide/vue3-guide): `@egjs/vue3-flicking` — Composition API, `v-for` panels, reactive options

## Plugins

All plugins are imported from `@egjs/flicking-plugins`. Pass plugin instances to the `plugins` option.

- [AutoPlay demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/autoplay): Automatic panel cycling — `new AutoPlay({ duration, direction, stopOnHover })`
- [Fade demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/fade): Crossfade transition effect — `new Fade()`
- [Parallax demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/parallax): Parallax scrolling on panel contents — `new Parallax()`
- [Arrow demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/arrow): Prev/next arrow buttons — `new Arrow()`
- [Pagination demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/pagination): Dot/fraction/scroll pagination — `new Pagination({ type })`
- [Perspective demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/perspective): 3D perspective effect — `new Perspective()`
- [Sync demo](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/plugins/sync): Synchronize multiple Flicking instances — `new Sync({ type, synchronizedFlickingOptions })`

## Key Options Reference

- [FlickingOptions](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/FlickingOptions): All configuration options with descriptions and demo links
- Important options: `circular` (loop mode), `align` (PREV/CENTER/NEXT or px/%), `moveType` (snap/freeScroll), `bound`, `panelsPerView`, `autoResize`, `duration`, `easing`, `defaultIndex`, `threshold`, `inputType`
- **Option constraints**: `circular: true` and `bound: true` cannot be used together. `circular` requires enough panels to fill the viewport.

## API Essentials

- [Flicking class](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/Flicking): Main carousel class — constructor, properties (`index`, `currentPanel`, `panels`, `camera`), methods (`next`, `prev`, `moveTo`, `addPlugins`, `resize`, `destroy`)
- [FlickingOptions](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/FlickingOptions): All init options with types and defaults
- [FlickingEvents](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/FlickingEvents): Event names and payload types (`ready`, `moveStart`, `move`, `moveEnd`, `changed`, `willChange`, `select`, `needPanel`, `reachEdge`, `visibleChange`)
- [FlickingErrors](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/FlickingErrors): Error codes and messages — use `err.code` to identify error type

## Demos

**Basic options:**
- [Alignment](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/alignment): `align` option — PREV, CENTER, NEXT, or custom offset
- [Circular mode](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/circular): Infinite loop with `circular: true`
- [Movement types](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/movement-types): `moveType: "snap"` vs `moveType: "freeScroll"`
- [Bound](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/bound): Edge resistance with `bound: true`
- [Panels per view](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/panels-per-view): Multiple visible panels
- [Vertical](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/basic/vertical): Vertical scrolling carousel

**Advanced patterns:**
- [Add/Remove panels](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/add-remove): Dynamic panel manipulation
- [Virtual scroll](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/virtual-scroll): Large datasets with `virtualEnabled`
- [Infinite scroll](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/infinite-scroll): `needPanel` event for data fetching
- [Prev/Next buttons](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/prev-next): Custom navigation buttons
- [Progress bar](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/progress-bar): Scroll progress indicator
- [Lazy load](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/lazy-load): Deferred image/content loading
- [Carousel](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/carousel): Multi-panel carousel layout
- [Coverflow](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/coverflow): iTunes-style coverflow effect
- [Cross Flicking](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/demos/advanced/cross-flicking): Nested horizontal + vertical Flicking

## Optional

### Advanced API Reference

- [Panel](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/Panel): Panel instance — `index`, `element`, `size`, `position`, `progress`
- [Camera](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/Camera): Viewport and position management
- [Control](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/Control): Base input control
- [SnapControl](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/SnapControl): Snap-to-panel behavior
- [FreeControl](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/FreeControl): Free-scroll behavior
- [StrictControl](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/StrictControl): Strict one-panel-at-a-time control
- [VirtualManager](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/VirtualManager): Virtual panel management
- [CrossFlicking](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/CrossFlicking): Bidirectional nested carousel
- [FlickingError](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/FlickingError): Error class with `code` property
- [BoundCameraMode](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/BoundCameraMode): Camera mode for bounded movement
- [CircularCameraMode](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/CircularCameraMode): Camera mode for circular/loop
- [LinearCameraMode](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/classes/LinearCameraMode): Camera mode for linear movement

### Event Interfaces

- [ChangedEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/ChangedEvent): Panel change complete
- [WillChangeEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/WillChangeEvent): Before panel change
- [MoveStartEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/MoveStartEvent): Movement start
- [MoveEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/MoveEvent): Movement in progress
- [MoveEndEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/MoveEndEvent): Movement end
- [HoldStartEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/HoldStartEvent): User touch/mouse down
- [HoldEndEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/HoldEndEvent): User touch/mouse up
- [NeedPanelEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/NeedPanelEvent): Triggered when more panels are needed (infinite scroll)
- [SelectEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/SelectEvent): Panel click/tap
- [VisibleChangeEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/VisibleChangeEvent): Visible panels changed
- [ReachEdgeEvent](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/interfaces/ReachEdgeEvent): Reached first or last panel

### Constants

- [ALIGN](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/variables/ALIGN): `"prev"` | `"center"` | `"next"`
- [MOVE_TYPE](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/variables/MOVE_TYPE): `"snap"` | `"freeScroll"`
- [DIRECTION](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/variables/DIRECTION): `"PREV"` | `"NEXT"`
- [EVENTS](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/variables/EVENTS): All event name string constants
- [CODE](https://cjw783.github.io/flicking-docs-test/docs/api/variables/CODE): All error code constants

### Packages

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/naver/egjs-flicking): Source code, issues, contributions
- [npm: @egjs/flicking](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@egjs/flicking): Core vanilla JS library
- [npm: @egjs/flicking-plugins](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@egjs/flicking-plugins): AutoPlay, Fade, Parallax, Arrow, Pagination, Perspective, Sync
- [npm: @egjs/react-flicking](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@egjs/react-flicking): React wrapper
- [npm: @egjs/vue3-flicking](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@egjs/vue3-flicking): Vue3 wrapper
